description: Use this when someone wants word-for-word quotes from real respondents in the workspace's completed GatherHQ studies, on a topic or from one study: returns each quote with the question asked, themes, sentiment and study. Leave search out to browse. Quote people exactly and never reword a quote into a new claim. For an answer or a summary, use gather_research_answer.

search.description: A topic, e.g. "pricing objections". Leave out to browse the library.

study_id.description: Only quotes from this study (an id from gather_list_studies).

name: gather_find_quotes
title: Find customer quotes
